editorial.blurb: Alice & Friends' Vegan Kitchen proves that plant-based dining can be inventive, crave-worthy, and genuinely fun—their ramen and laksa are standouts that even non-vegans won't forget.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive without a reservation as a group; they accommodated a party of 13 on a Sunday with no wait, and their spacious back seating belies the small storefront.
